recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Read, Lake, Agertz, Debattista 2008; Read et al. 2009

Fiducial direct-detection dark disk v_lag = 50, sigma = 50 km/s
Gaia-era limits on a thin dark disk: surface density <~ 3-6 Msun/pc^2 for scale heights <~ 100 pc; thicker disks much less constrained
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Schutz, Lin, Safdi, Wu 2018; Buch, Leung, Fan 2019

|x| for x ~ N(m, sigma^2 I_3) follows a non-central chi distribution with 3 dof and non-centrality (|m|/sigma)^2

Exothermic recoil window E+ - E- = (2 mu^2 v^2/m_N) sqrt(1 + 2|delta|/(mu v^2)) ~ (2 mu/m_N) v sqrt(2 mu |delta|); integrated exothermic rate independent of the velocity distribution to O(mu v^2/|delta|)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: derived by hand from two-body kinematics

recalled_knowledge.item: rho_0 ~ 0.3 GeV/cm^3 is a local dynamical measurement that includes any disk dark matter, so a disk fraction replaces rather than adds halo density
